reasons.dotnet.grpc: The .NET gRPC server builds against Confluent.Kafka.csproj and Directory.Build.props, and both changed.
reasons.dotnet.performance: The performance tests build against Confluent.Kafka.csproj and Directory.Build.props, and both changed.
reasons.dotnet.soak: SoakClient.Tests builds against Confluent.Kafka.csproj and Directory.Build.props, and both changed.
reasons.dotnet.solution: Directory.Build.props, Confluent.Kafka.csproj (new net462 target), Utf8Marshal.cs, the analyzer allowlist and baseline, the unit-test csproj and ProducerSubmitHandleRefTests changed, which affects how every solution test is built and run.
